text:
jules: Quick shoutout to Marco and Facilities for the last-minute AV + plant-watering rescue this morning. conference room looked like a hurricane but demo still went smooth :raised_hands: :seedling:

marco: nothing like a sprint and a watering can to get the blood moving. big thanks to Facilities for lending the tall ladder and the miracle HDMI splitter.

tanya: also applause for Sam who stepped in to rerun the script and kept the logs neat so the demo team could breathe :clap: (reactions: :tada: x3)

sam: i will accept my unofficial role as "script whisperer". also shout to whoever left the mini scones in the pantry  saved my afternoon. :scone:

facilities: glad we could help! tiny note: we found a crate of extra kombucha behind the AV cupboard  apologies if someone was stockpiling it :sweat_smile: 

jules: kombucha mystery noted. we should probably put a label. i'll drop a sticky on the shelf.

marco: can we do a small thank-you for Facilities? lunchbot: create poll?

lunchbot: Poll: "Thank-you for Facilities"  React: 1 Donut box, 2 Sushi rolls, 3 Coffee + pastry spread. Poll open 6h.

tanya: :three: coffee+pasteries from me. high caffeine = sustained gratitude.

sam: :one: donuts. maple pls.

jules: filing a tiny kudos card now. kudosbot: Created kudos card for Marco and Facilities. Summary: "AV + plant rescue + kombucha discovery  swift teamwork saved the morning demo." (id: K-395777-01)

marco: thanks y'all. small thank-you goes a long way. also who took the last kombucha? :eyes:
